data.description: Beach Access | Elegant Furnishings | Breathtaking Views
data.long_description:
Discover the pinnacle of luxury living at 1 JBR, one of Dubai's most sought-after addresses. This exceptional waterfront residence boasts breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Palm Jumeirah. With direct access to the beach, residents can indulge in a peaceful coastal retreat while being just moments away from the dynamic pulse of the city.

Property Details:

- 3 Master Bedrooms + en-suite
- Largest Maid Room ( Study Room)
- 1 Large Balcony
- 2 Spacious Storage Rooms
- Fully Equipped Open Kitchen
- Floor-to-ceiling windows
- Built-in Wardrobes
- Guest Water Closet
- Panoramic Sea View / Palm Jumeirah View / Dubai Eye View
- Private Lobby
- Private Elevator
- Mid Floor
- Chiller empower
- Gas electrical
- 2 Free Parking Spots
- 10% deposit
- 2130 AED - DEWA (for 1st time residence in Dubai)
- EJARI
